basic_details.job_title: NEEPCO Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: North Eastern Electric Power Corporation Limited (NEEPCO) has announced 4 vacancies for Executive Trainee (Safety) posts under its 2026 recruitment drive. Selected candidates will undergo a 1-year training period, after which they are placed in E-3 grade. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000/- (IDA). Eligible candidates can apply online from 11 October 2026 to 31 October 2026 through the official website. The selection process consists of scrutiny of online applications followed by a Computer Based Test and Personal Interview.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limits calculated as on 01-07-2026 are: | UR: 30 Years SC: 35 Years OBC (NCL): 33 Years

qualification.details: Candidates must possess a full-time diploma in industrial safety with a minimum of 65% marks (55% marks for Scheduled Caste candidates) along with a degree in engineering in Mechanical, Electrical, or Production from a recognized institute; OR a degree in engineering in Industrial Safety/Fire and Safety with a minimum of 65% marks (55% marks for SC candidates) from a recognized institute under the same provisions.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be placed in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000/-. Their monthly emoluments will include basic pay, DA, HRA (where corporation accommodation is not available) @ 35% of basic pay for cafeteria, Site Allowance (LBA) @ 10% of basic pay + DA, and contribution towards EPF and NEEDCSS (NEEPCO Defined Contribution Superannuation Pension Scheme) @ 9% of basic pay + DA. Additional benefits include leave, medical benefits for self and dependent family members, Performance Related Pay (PRP), gratuity, uniform, communication expenses, and furniture reimbursement as applicable per company rules. The minimum monthly CTC is approximately Rs. 1,00,000/-. Upon successful completion of the 1-year training period at one or more corporation locations, trainees will be placed in E-3 grade.

how_to_apply: Log on to the official website at www.neepco.co.in and navigate to the "Careers" section.

Fill out the online application form with accurate details regarding graduation marks, percentages, and experience.

Upload scanned copies of required documents, including proof of date of birth, complete mark sheets and certificates for X, XII, and Engineering graduation, experience certificates, category certificates (in Government of India format, with OBC-NCL issued in the current financial year), PwBD certificate, conversion certificate for grade/CGPA to percentage, recent passport-size color photograph (JPEG, 20 KB to 100 KB), and signature (JPEG, 20 KB to 100 KB).
Submit the online application and take a printout of the system-generated registration slip/form for future reference.

content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides a total of 4 vacancies for the Executive Trainee (Safety) post, categorized as follows:

rows.post_grade: Executive Trainee (Safety) (E-2 Grade, Post Code: HR/85)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a full-time diploma in industrial safety with a minimum of 65% marks (55% marks for Scheduled Caste candidates) along with a degree in engineering in Mechanical, Electrical, or Production from a recognized institute; OR a degree in engineering in Industrial Safety/Fire and Safety with a minimum of 65% marks (55% marks for SC candidates) from a recognized institute under the same provisions. 1 (one) year of post-qualification experience in statutory safety compliance, development or auditing of safety systems, promotion of safety culture, and safety inspection of machinery and buildings under the Factories Act. Experience in safety training and firefighting will be considered an added advantage. The maximum age limits calculated as on 01-07-2026 are: UR: 30 Years SC: 35 Years OBC (NCL): 33 Years

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000/-. Their monthly emoluments will include basic pay, DA, HRA (where corporation accommodation is not available) @ 35% of basic pay for cafeteria, Site Allowance (LBA) @ 10% of basic pay + DA, and contribution towards EPF and NEEDCSS (NEEPCO Defined Contribution Superannuation Pension Scheme) @ 9% of basic pay + DA. Additional benefits include leave, medical benefits for self and dependent family members, Performance Related Pay (PRP), gratuity, uniform, communication expenses, and furniture reimbursement as applicable per company rules. The minimum monthly CTC is approximately Rs. 1,00,000/-. Upon successful completion of the 1-year training period at one or more corporation locations, trainees will be placed in E-3 grade.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEEPCO Executive Trainee (Safety)
content_sections.text: Log on to the official website at www.neepco.co.in and navigate to the "Careers" section. Candidates belonging to General, EWS, and OBC (NCL) categories must pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 560/- through SBI e-Pay. SC, ESM, and female candidates are exempted from the application fee, though SC, ST, and PwBD candidates applying for unreserved posts must pay the fee. Fill out the online application form with accurate details regarding graduation marks, percentages, and experience. Upload scanned copies of required documents, including proof of date of birth, complete mark sheets and certificates for X, XII, and Engineering graduation, experience certificates, category certificates (in Government of India format, with OBC-NCL issued in the current financial year), PwBD certificate, conversion certificate for grade/CGPA to percentage, recent passport-size color photograph (JPEG, 20 KB to 100 KB), and signature (JPEG, 20 KB to 100 KB). Submit the online application and take a printout of the system-generated registration slip/form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises the scrutiny of online applications, a Computer Based Test (CBT), and a Personal Interview. The shortlisting of applications is based on marks obtained in the engineering degree and industrial safety diploma/degree along with experience. The CBT consists of two sections: Section 1 (Professional Knowledge Test / SKT) on Industrial Safety / Fire & Safety carrying 75 marks, and Section 2 (Executive Aptitude Test / EAT) on numerical ability, reading comprehension, reasoning, general awareness, data interpretation, etc., carrying 25 marks. The exam paper contains 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each, with a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer. The duration of the exam is 2 hours.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NEEPCO Executive Trainee (Safety) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee for General, EWS, and OBC (NCL) candidates is Rs. 560/-.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary or stipend during the training period?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive a pay scale of Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000/- (IDA) with a minimum monthly CTC of approximately Rs. 1,00,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. Are HRA and other allowances paid in addition to the basic pay?
faq.answer: Yes, monthly emoluments include basic pay, DA, HRA, cafeteria allowance @ 35% of basic pay, site allowance @ 10%, provident fund, and NEEDCSS pension scheme contribution, along with medical benefits and other allowances.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Relaxation in upper age limit is admissible for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), ESM, and PwBD candidates as per Government of India guidelines, including those who were ordinarily domiciled in Jammu and Kashmir between 01.01.1980 and 31.12.1989.
